resources.string: Speed on a dial with numbers, plus distance or average speed, two spots above the dial (default: shifting battery and gear; SRAM AXS, or Shimano Di2 via Ki2), and three round fields you choose in Settings. Follows the Karoo light or dark mode and units. Best in a large field.
The Ride Meter with power (W) on the dial and average power under it. The scale follows your FTP. Speed moves to the first round field.
The Ride Meter with 3-second average power (W) on the dial and average power under it. The scale follows your FTP. Speed moves to the first round field.
The Ride Meter with heart rate (60–200 bpm) on the dial and average heart rate under it. Speed moves to the first round field.
The Ride Meter with cadence (0–140 rpm) on the dial and average cadence under it. Speed moves to the first round field.
With imperial units on the Karoo the scale is 0–20, 30, 40 or 60 mph. Power, heart rate and cadence fields set their own scale.
The meter follows the Karoo light or dark mode. In light mode Normal and Bright both use the bright colours; Classic stays classic.
Small dial with needle (speed, power, heart rate, cadence, slope)
Field 1 (left; top in a wide field)
Field 3 (right; bottom in a wide field)
In the Power, Heart Rate and Cadence versions of the Ride Meter, field 1 shows speed and the other two show your choices without the value already on the dial.
Saved immediately. An open Ride Meter updates within a second.
